message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. The facts: The defendant Sun1 (孙1某) and others formed a gang to help fraudsters (上线) withdraw money from bank accounts. They took bank cards with money transferred by fraudsters, then withdrew cash and returned money. This is facilitating fraud, i.e., "帮助诈骗罪" (helping fraud). Under Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: "帮助诈骗罪" (Article 266 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "组织、领导、参加诈骗犯罪集团" (if they organized a group). The facts say they formed a specialized group to help fraudsters withdraw money. That could be "组织、领导、参加诈骗犯罪集团" (Article 266). Also "诈骗罪" is the principal fraud, but they are not the principal, they are accomplices. So the appropriate charge is "帮助诈骗罪". Also possibly "非法获取金融机构账户信息罪"? But they just used bank cards given by fraudsters. The main crime is "帮助诈骗罪". Could also be "非法占有他人财物罪"? No, they returned money. So answer: [罪名]帮助诈骗罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple crimes: Could be "组织、领导诈骗犯罪集团罪"? The law: Article 266: "组织、领导、参加诈骗犯罪集团的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑，并处罚金或者没收财产。" So they formed a group. The charge could be "组织、领导诈骗犯罪集团罪". However the facts: "形成一个专门帮助诈骗犯罪分子取款的团伙". That is a group. So they could be charged with "组织、领导诈骗犯罪集团罪". Also "帮助诈骗罪". Usually prosecutors may charge both: "组织、领导诈骗犯罪集团罪" (if they are leaders) and "帮助诈骗罪". But the question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts support both: they formed a group (组织、领导) and they helped fraudsters withdraw money (帮助诈骗). So we can list both separated by ';'.

Thus final answer: [罪名]帮助诈骗罪;组织、领导诈骗犯罪集团罪<eoa>
